objective: test accepted-volume chamber/valve/load transaction architecture under strict morphology V1.1

variants.label: Current pressure-flow frontier without accepted-volume ownership
variants.chamberValveLoadContract: Baseline accepted-state AV pressure-flow path; chamber volume remains continuity-only.

variants.label: Accepted-volume pressure/valve/load transaction
variants.chamberValveLoadContract: Search same-step accepted ventricular volume and recompute chamber pressure plus inlet/outlet valve flow at that volume.

variants.label: Accepted-volume transaction plus stateful AV valve V2
variants.chamberValveLoadContract: Combine same-step accepted ventricular volume with stateful AV pressure-flow/loss/inertance ownership.

variants.label: Accepted-volume transaction plus AV and semilunar V2
variants.chamberValveLoadContract: Extend the accepted-volume transaction to both AV inflow and semilunar outflow valve pressure-flow/loss/inertance leads.
